newsitem.title: UK: Russia July seaborne crude exports 1.57 mbpd-Petra.
newsitem.headline: Russia July seaborne crude exports 1.57 mbpd-Petra.

text.p: Russian seaborne crude exports in July totalled 1.574 million barrels per day (bpd), 333,000 bpd higher than in June, shipping inspectors Petrak said.
Crude exports from the main Black Sea terminal of Novorossiisk ran at 685,570 bpd compared to 803,347 bpd in June but were still ahead of the average so far for the year.
The fall at Novorossiisk was offset by a big jump in exports from Tuapse, where 331,788 bpd of crude were shipped in July compared with 101,261 bpd in June.
The third Black Sea port of Odessa shipped 259,927 bpd in July, a shade lower than the previous month.
Ventspils on the Baltic moved 293,416 bpd, in line with its average for the year.
